# Holographic sweep

A band of rainbow light sweeps across like a hologram catching the light, bending the image as it passes and leaving the next image behind it.

<EffectDemo effect="holo-sweep" />

## Usage

```ts
import { createTransition, toHoloEffect } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { holoSweep } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/holo-sweep';

const effect = holoSweep({ preset: 'foil' });

// Standalone: blend two textures as progress goes from 0 to 1.
const player = createTransition(renderer, effect, {
  from: textureA,
  to: textureB,
});
player.progress = 0.5;
player.render();

// With HoloCSS: hand it to transition3d().
import { transition3d } from '@mk7s/holocss/three';
await transition3d(fromElement, toElement, toHoloEffect(effect), {
  target,
  update,
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.angle = 20`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type   | Default | Range        | Description                                                   |
| ------------ | ------ | ------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `angle`      | number | `20`    | -180 – 180 ° | Direction the band travels.                                   |
| `width`      | number | `0.18`  | 0.02 – 0.6   | Width of the band, as a fraction of the sweep.                |
| `intensity`  | number | `1.2`   | 0 – 4        | Brightness of the spectrum.                                   |
| `refraction` | number | `0.02`  | 0 – 0.1      | How far the band bends the image, as a fraction of the frame. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                         |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `foil`     | `width: 0.3`, `intensity: 2`, `refraction: 0.03` |
| `thin`     | `width: 0.06`, `intensity: 2.5`                  |
| `vertical` | `angle: -90`                                     |

Apply one with `holoSweep({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Transitions · tracked as story X13.10 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** transition. `createTransition(renderer, effect, { from, to })` runs it on two textures; `toHoloEffect(effect)` turns it into a HoloCSS `ThreeEffect` (parameters are baked in when called), with the `hcss-swing-left` CSS fallback. See [transitions](/guide/transitions).
- **Motion:** driven by `progress` from your timeline. HoloCSS skips transitions when motion is off; standalone, set `progress = 1` instead of animating.
- **Size:** 6.7 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/holo-sweep`, including the shared effect runtime.

Original implementation (MIT). References: A swept band of spectral color (CIE 1931 matching functions via the spectral chunk) with per-channel refraction.
